listing.title: Missions & Games
listing.subtitle: Master finance and entrepreneurship while overcoming interactive challenges.

startScreen.description: Drag each item to the correct monster!

tutorial.step1Desc: Vitalio eats NEEDS. Capricho eats WANTS.
tutorial.step2Desc: Swipe each falling item toward the correct monster.
tutorial.step3Desc: If you make a mistake or drop an item, you lose a heart. 3 mistakes and it's Game Over!
tutorial.dragInstruction:
DRAG ESSENTIALS TO GREEN.
FUN STUFF TO PURPLE.

drRho.name: Dr. Rho
drRho.tip1: Watch out! A need is something essential to live, like water. A want is something we like but can wait for.
drRho.tip2: Water, food, and shelter are basic needs. We can't live without them!
drRho.tip3: Think: can I live without this? If the answer is yes, it's a want.

zara.name: Zara
zara.tip1: Excellent budgeting! By identifying your expenses well, your savings grow.
zara.tip2: Wants are okay sometimes, but needs come first!
zara.tip3: Being smart with your money is a superpower. You can do it!

liruf.name: Liruf
liruf.tip1: Almost got it! I also bought too many toys before eating. Let's try again!
liruf.tip2: Wow, you're doing great! Keep dragging to the right monster!
liruf.tip3: The monsters are hungry! Feed them correctly!

dina.name: Dina
dina.tip1: Ran out of coins? No worries! Try again and remember: essentials first, fun later.
dina.tip2: Every decision counts. Needs keep your body and mind healthy!
dina.tip3: Wants are fun, but they're not essential. Prioritize!
